subject: Three-way marketplace demo sync / lock & prep
messages:
From: Allison Park <allison.park@helixsys.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Ravi Menon <ravi@si-integrations.com>, aws-marketplace-scheduling@amazon.com
Date: 2028-06-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Partner demo — multi-region marketplace run-through

Hi Jordan —

Thanks again for the product overview last week. Helix is excited to get a three-way demo lined up with Redwood + our SI (Ravi) and the Marketplace team to validate the procurement flow end-to-end (listing -> procurement -> dedicated capacity demo).

Can we aim for next Wed/Thu window (June 21/22) late-morning PT? Rough agenda: 15m intros, 30m product demo (Redwood hosted + Dedicated failover), 25m SI integration deep-dive, 10m Q&A + next steps. We anticipate ~8 people on our side (product, procurement, security).

I attached a first-pass runbook and the Helix non-sensitive attendee list. Also cc'd Ravi to confirm the SI host and AWS scheduling contact.

Attachments: runbook_v1.pdf, attendee_list.csv

Thanks —
Allison
Senior Partnerships, Helix Systems
allison.park@helixsys.com
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.inference.com>
To: Allison Park <allison.park@helixsys.com>
Cc: Ravi Menon <ravi@si-integrations.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.inference.com>, aws-marketplace-scheduling@amazon.com
Date: 2028-06-18T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Partner demo — multi-region marketplace run-through

Allison — appreciate the runbook. June 21 or 22 works for us; prefer Wednesday (21) between 10:30–13:00 PT. Proposed time block: 11:00–12:30 PT to give a 90-minute slot for buffering and a short tech-rehearse immediately before.

Quick asks from our side before we lock:
- Can Helix confirm the procurement personas who need to see the marketplace procurement flow? (PO vs legal vs SRE)
- Ravi / SI: who will own the integration demo (API flow vs infra provisioning)?
- Marketplace folks: do we need an AWS account sandbox for a live purchase, or will a mocked procurement be sufficient?

Ben, Kim — looping you in for host assignments. Vanessa, can you draft the calendar invite and share the runbook link + HubSpot deal?

I'll tentatively hold 11:00–12:30 PT on June 21 and will update once we hear back.

—Jordan
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.inference.com
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.inference.com>, Allison Park <allison.park@helixsys.com>
Cc: Ravi Menon <ravi@si-integrations.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2028-06-18T11:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Partner demo — multi-region marketplace run-through

Jordan / Allison —

11:00–12:30 PT on Jun 21 is fine from my side. Technical hosts: I'll take the Redwood hosted/demo portion (service layer, routing, fallback policies) and Ravi can cover SI provisioning & infra handoff. Kim can take the quant/latency section.

Recommendation: schedule a 30-minute dry run with all hosts the day before (Tue 20 @ 10:00 PT) to smoke-check the marketplace flow (tokens, billing metadata, listing SKU match). We had a procurement hiccup last quarter when a SKU mapping wasn't consistent — want to avoid that live.

Attachments: ops-checklist.xlsx

—Ben
Senior Solutions Engineer
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.inference.com>
To: Allison Park <allison.park@helixsys.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.inference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>, Ravi Menon <ravi@si-integrations.com>, aws-marketplace-scheduling@amazon.com
Date: 2028-06-18T13:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Partner demo — multi-region marketplace run-through

Thanks team — calendar invite created and shared. Link + docs below:
- Runbook (drive): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcD-runbook-helix
- HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/HLX-2028-Q2-47

Invite details: June 21, 11:00–12:30 PT / 14:00–15:30 ET — "Redwood x Helix x SI — Marketplace demo / integration run-through". I put a 30-minute host dry-run Tue 20 at 10:00 PT; please accept if you can make it.

Attachments referenced in invite: runbook_v1.pdf, ops-checklist.xlsx

On a logistics note: AWS scheduling asked whether we require a live AMI/image to provision or if a staging template is okay. Allison — is Helix comfortable with a staging sandbox? If not, please flag and we'll loop the marketplace team for a provisioning SLA.

—Vanessa
Program Manager, Partner GTM | Redwood Inference
From: Ravi Menon <ravi@si-integrations.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.inference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.inference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>, Allison Park <allison.park@helixsys.com>, aws-marketplace-scheduling@amazon.com
Date: 2028-06-19T14:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Partner demo — multi-region marketplace run-through

All —

Confirmed: SI will present the provisioning flow and validate the marketplace SKU mapping. We are OK with a staging sandbox (Helix has no policy against it) — that will reduce risk for a live purchase. I'll prepare a short infra checklist and share screenshots of the staging environment by EOD Monday.

Also confirm dry-run Tue 20 @ 10:00 PT. Looking forward to it.

Best,
Ravi
Director, Integrations | SI Integrations
